info.title: crowpond gateway API
info.summary: Generic ingest and retrieval of labelled data objects.
info.description:
Live data in PostgreSQL, past data archived as Parquet, files in a bucket, one REST API in front.

**Authentication.** Every operation except `/healthz` and `/openapi.json` needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A token has the role `api` or `admin`. Operations marked `api` accept either role; operations marked `admin` need an admin token. Tokens are issued with `POST /tokens`. The role is given as the scope of the `bearerAuth` requirement.

**Errors.** Failures are `{"detail": ...}`: a message string, or for malformed input (422) a list of `{type, loc, msg}`. Unknown paths give 404, and a known path with the wrong method 405, both as `{"detail": "Not Found"}` / `{"detail": "Method Not Allowed"}`. Authentication is checked before the body is validated. The format is not yet RFC 9457 Problem Details.

**Pagination.** Lists use keyset cursors: the response's `next` is passed back as `after` (`_after` for table rows) until it is `null`. The audit log and object list are ordered by their time-ordered UUID; table rows by `(created_at, object_id)`. Tokens and proposals are returned whole.

**Tracing.** Send a W3C `traceparent` request header to continue your trace. Every response carries a `traceparent` header (a new span of the same trace, or a new trace when the request had none or an invalid one).

servers.description: Replace with your gateway's base URL.

tags.name: Label policies
tags.description: Registry of STANAG 4774 label policies. PUBLIC and NATO are built in; admins register others.

get.description: No authentication. Runs `SELECT 1`; a database failure gives 500.

200.description: The service and its database are up.

get.description: No authentication, like `/healthz`: the document describes the API and contains nothing about any deployment. It is the `openapi.json` file of the gateway repository, served unchanged.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document.

post.summary: Register a schema (or a new version)
post.description: Table creation is manual: this and approving a proposal are the only ways a typed table comes to exist. Later versions may only add columns.

201.description: Registered. Creates the typed table for a first version.

get.description: Keyset pagination on `object_id` (UUIDv7, time-ordered): pass `next` as `after` until it is null.

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: `created_at` lower bound, inclusive. A time without an offset is UTC.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Metadata filters, written as separate parameters `metadata.<key>=<value>` or `metadata.<key>.<op>=<value>` (`op`: `eq` (default), `ne`, `in`, `null`, `prefix`, `contains`). Values are compared as text against the catalog row's `metadata`. Unknown operators give 422. Other unknown parameters are ignored.

200.description: One page, oldest first, without payloads.

post.summary: Ingest a record or describe a file
post.description: Records are stored as-is (matched or validated against a schema). For a file: `PUT` the content to `upload_url`, then call `POST /objects/{id}/commit`. A single record can also go straight into a bulk table by naming it in `schema` (no catalog row is written then); use `POST /tables/{table}/records` for batches.

201.description: A record is stored, or a file is registered as `pending` and an upload URL returned.

200.description: The catalog row and, for a record, its payload (from either tier).

delete.description: Deletes a file (bucket object and catalog row) or a record still in PostgreSQL. A record already archived to Parquet gives 409.

200.description: Deleted.

post.description: Checks the uploaded size and SHA-256 against what `POST /objects` declared. 409 when nothing was uploaded or it does not match.

200.description: Committed (idempotent).

post.description: Deletes files past their `retention_days`, and audit rows past `AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS`. A bounded batch per call: repeat while `more` is true.

200.description: The sweep ran; `status` is `failed` when some deletions failed.
Every table with row counts across both tiers, file totals and pending proposals.
Stats, columns, JSON Schema and schema versions.

get.summary: Filtered rows of a typed table
get.description: Reads PostgreSQL and the verified Parquet archive as one snapshot. At most 31 archive files are opened per request, so a page can be short and still carry `next`: follow it until it is null. The `generic` table cannot be filtered by field (422); use `GET /objects`.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Column filters, as separate parameters: `<column>=<value>` or `<column>.<op>=<value>` (`op`: `eq ne gt gte lt lte in null prefix contains`, limited by column type), and `extra.<key>[.<op>]=<value>` for fields without a column (text comparison). Unknown columns and unknown parameters give 422.

parameters.name: _id
parameters.description: One row. For a bulk table the id must be a UUIDv7, or give `_created_from` and `_created_to`.

parameters.name: _after
parameters.description: Cursor: the previous page's `next` (an `object_id` is also accepted, but not for bulk tables).

200.description: One page across live and archived data.

post.summary: Batch ingest into a bulk table
post.description: Also works for any typed table. 1 to 1000 records per call; each is validated against the schema, and the whole batch is rejected on the first failure.

201.description: All records stored in one transaction.

200.description: Saved.
Per-table tier counts and the ten most recent runs.

post.description: Moves whole past days older than the hot window from PostgreSQL to hourly Parquet files. Synchronous: the request returns when the run is done.

200.description: The run finished (`status` `failed` lists errors) or was skipped because another run holds the lock.

post.description: Clusters unmatched records in `generic` by field set and proposes schemas. Proposals are never applied automatically.

200.description: Proposal ids created and updated.
All proposals, oldest first (not paginated).
The proposal.

post.description: Registers the schema (optionally edited in the body), creates the table and moves matching rows, in one transaction.

200.description: Approved: the table exists and matching rows were moved out of `generic`.
Rejected.
Newest first, never including secrets (not paginated).
Revoked. Revoking an already revoked token succeeds.

get.description: Keyset pagination on `audit_id`: oldest first by default, `order=desc` for newest first; pass `next` as `after`.

parameters.name: target_id
parameters.description: What the request was aimed at.

200.description: One page of audit rows.

get.description: Built-in (`PUBLIC`, `NATO`) and registered policies. Not paginated.

200.description: Built-ins first, then registered policies by creation time.

post.description: Identifier and classifications are stored uppercase. A built-in identifier cannot be reused (409). Only policy and classification are modelled, not categories, privacy marks or releasability.

200.description: The policy.

delete.description: Only while nothing refers to it (objects, bulk tables, archive files); otherwise 409. Built-in policies cannot be deleted (403).

200.description: Deleted; the removed policy.

bearerAuth.description: A token issued by `POST /tokens` (or `bin/create-token`). The scope list on an operation names the role it needs: `api` (any valid token) or `admin`.

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context of this request: `00-<trace id>-<span id>-<flags>`. Same trace id as the request's `traceparent` when it was valid.

Table.name: table
Table.description: Table name (`generic` or a typed table's `table_name`).

Traceparent.name: traceparent
Traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context to continue (`00-<32 hex>-<16 hex>-<2 hex>`, lower case, no all-zero ids). Invalid values are ignored and a new trace starts.

Forbidden.description: The token is unknown or revoked (`invalid token`), or the route needs the admin role (`admin token required`).

NotFound.description: No such resource, or no such route.

Conflict.description: The resource is in a state that does not allow this.

Invalid.description: The request is invalid. `detail` is a message string for rule violations, or a list of `{type, loc, msg}` for malformed input.

ServerError.description: Unexpected failure (`Internal Server Error`), or an archive file failed its size/digest check (`archive integrity check failed: ...`).

BadGateway.description: An archive file cannot be read from the bucket.

NoStorage.description: File storage is not configured (`BUCKET_NAME` unset).

policy.description: STANAG 4774 originator policy identifier: a built-in (`PUBLIC`, `NATO`) or a registered policy, matched case-insensitively and stored uppercase. A `NATO` label implies NATO ownership and must not be used for open data.

classification.description: A classification defined by the policy (see `GET /label-policies`), matched case-insensitively and stored uppercase.

Label.description: STANAG 4774 originator confidentiality label. An unknown policy, or a classification the policy does not define, is rejected with 422.

Detail.description: Error body for every failure except request validation. This is not yet RFC 9457 Problem Details.

loc.description: Where the problem is: `body`, `query` or `path`, then the field path.

ValidationDetail.description: Body-, query- or path-parameter validation errors (422), in FastAPI's list format.

name.description: Schema name; letters, digits and underscore (an SQL-safe identifier).

table_name.description: Table the schema creates, in the `data` schema. Same identifier rules as `name`.

json_schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 object describing the payload; top-level properties become columns.

catalog.description: `record`: one catalog row per record. `table`: a bulk table with no per-record catalog row; needs `owner` and `source`.

size.description: Bytes; 1 to 5 GiB (a single presigned PUT).

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the content; checked at commit.

owner.description: Required, except for a record sent to a bulk table with `schema`: then it may be left out, or must equal the table's fixed owner.

source.description: Required, except for a record sent to a bulk table with `schema`.

schema.description: Name of a registered schema to validate the record against (records only). `schema_name` is accepted as an alias.

payload.description: Any JSON value. Send exactly one of `payload` or `file`.

metadata.description: Free-form catalog metadata; filterable with `metadata.<key>` on `GET /objects`. For files the server adds `filename`.

retention_days.description: Files only: the cleanup job deletes the file after this many days.

IngestRequest.description: Send exactly one of `payload` (a record) or `file` (a file to upload).

upload_url.description: Presigned URL; PUT the content here, then commit.

upload_headers.description: Headers to send with the PUT.

upload_expires_in.description: Seconds the upload URL stays valid.

digest_sha256.description: Absent when the file was already committed.

status.description: `committed`, or `pending` for a file awaiting upload.

tier.description: `archived` once a record moved to Parquet; otherwise live.

table.description: Table the record is stored in; `generic` for unmatched records.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last page.

payload.description: Records only: the stored JSON payload, from PostgreSQL or the verified Parquet archive.

download_url.description: Committed files only: presigned GET URL.

archive.description: Archived records only: the archive file the record was read from.

more.description: True when the per-run limit was reached; run again.

items.description: One row; keys are the table's schema fields.

hot_days.description: Full past UTC days kept in PostgreSQL besides today.
Per-table override; null means the HOT_DAYS default.

allOf.description: Typed tables carry `version`, `auto_match`, `catalog`, `columns` and `json_schema`; bulk tables also `owner`, `source` and `label`.

next.description: Opaque cursor; pass as `_after`. Present even on a short page when the per-request archive file cap was hit. Null on the last page.

runs.description: The ten most recent runs, newest first.

oneOf.description: Another archive run holds the job lock.

excluded.description: Fields left out of the proposed schema, with reasons.

ApproveRequest.description: Optional body. Overrides what the proposal suggested.

created_by.description: Recorded as the creator; defaults to `admin`.

secret.description: The plaintext bearer token. Shown once, never again.

detail.description: Counts and names only; never bodies, payloads, URLs or secrets.

next.description: Pass as `after`; continues in the same direction.

policy.description: Letters, digits, single spaces and `. _ -`; stored uppercase.

uri.description: Optional absolute URI of the policy, e.g. `urn:oid:...`. Omitted from the binding when absent.

classifications.description: Ordered lowest to highest; same character rules as `policy`.
